content.title: Personalized Anniversary Mug, Botanical Names and Date, Couple Keepsake
content.description:
Celebrate the date your story began. Two botanical stems meet in a warm gold knot, framing two names and a meaningful date on a white 11oz ceramic mug. The restrained green-and-gold composition makes a personal anniversary keepsake for everyday coffee or a quiet moment together.

Personalize the design with each partner’s first name and your chosen date. The names appear on separate lines, in the order you provide. This listing is for one physical mug; scene props are not included. Colors can appear differently on screens and the finished print.

Please check spelling, accents, name order and date carefully before submitting. Submit the date as YYYY-MM-DD (for example, 2021-06-18); alternative display styles require manual confirmation. Your personalized layout will be reviewed manually before fulfillment. If a requested combination needs clarification, we will contact you before proceeding.

Design process: developed with AI assistance and seller direction.
